body.title: Remove JetBrains lifecycle controls and update contracts
body.summary: Remove identified gateway lifecycle methods/types/fields,settings daemon lifecycle panel/restart execution and corresponding mixed JUnit slices; dedicated lifecycle/freshness sources were deleted in t2. Preserve generic RPC,status,backup/compact,model/settings workflow and project/host onboarding contracts.
acceptanceChecks: All JetBrains member entries are accounted for; no removed controller/resource/import remains wired in surviving code.
Generic gateway and backup/compact/status DTOs survive; only update-specific fields and methods are removed.
Mixed settings/model tests preserve save/decision/error semantics rather than deleting the whole test or flow.

tests.name: Focused surviving JetBrains gateway/settings/model/onboarding JUnit classes through existing jetbrains-plugin/test-bridge/run-focused-junit.ts where available (executed in t8).
